description: A bordered box with four different corner radii -- background and border ring must both follow the rounded outline, checked against Chromium's own rasterization.

florui.css: .box { width: 52px; height: 52px; background-color: #4c8bf5; border-width: 4px; border-style: solid; border-color: #1e3a8a; border-radius: 20px 8px 30px 12px; }

classification.reason: Chromium's and tiny-skia's anti-aliasing of a curved edge never agree pixel for pixel. Measured against desktop Chrome: 3.09% of pixels differ (mean_error 0.756, max_error 74 on a few edge pixels), geometry an exact 60x60 match -- edge coverage only, no shape or position difference. Not re-measured against a software-rendered CI Chromium.
